versions.content: Service Name So Ad_ Read Dhcp Host Name Option Syntax Std_ Return Type So Ad_ Read Dhcp Host Name Option ( So Ad_ So Con Id Type So Con Id, uint8* length, uint8* data ) Service ID [hex] 0x1A Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different So Con Ids. Non reentrant for the same So Con Id. Parameters (in) So Con Id socket connection index specifying the socket connection for which the hostname shall be read Parameters (inout) length As input parameter, contains the length of the provided data buffer. Will be overwritten with the length of the actual data. Parameters (out) data Pointer to provided memory buffer the hostname, i.e. the Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) according to IETF RFC 4702/ IETF RFC 4704 will be copied to. Return value Std _ - Return - Type E_ OK: The request has been accepted E_ NOT_ OK: The request has not been accepted Description By this API service an upper layer of the So Ad can read the currently configured hostname, i.e. FQDN option in the DHCP submodule of the TCP/ IP stack. Available via So Ad.h
